topology_reasoning: The target is a symmetric folded waveguide silhouette: two mirrored U-shaped lobe bundles at the top and bottom with a central stack of long horizontal bars. The black mass is best modeled as repeated constant-width primitives with rounded U-turns rather than a monolithic polygon. Function-defining knobs are the waveguide width, repeated pass pitch, bend radius, bar spacing, and the horizontal span of the repeated passes. The required delta_length knob is realized by extending one arm with a true straight segment so the measured path length and area both respond geometrically.
notes: Primitives will be Path/extrude, straight rectangles, and bends only.
Lengths.json will report two real path objects for verify_knob_response.
